body:
Disposition after checking the current caller: `ReclaimObservedValueLogSources` returns `ValueLogGCStats`, whose counters describe the observed primary value-log sources. It has always discarded the separate leaf-GC result on both success and failure; that caller and return type are unchanged by this PR. Combining immutable manifest or leaf-segment counters into the observed-vlog counters would change their meaning, and exposing the separate result requires an API change.

The direct backend `LeafGenerationGC` API retains and returns its actual completed revision deletions with an error; the new cancellation/late-inventory regression receipts exercise that behavior. The lifecycle harness reports that separate result directly. I am declining the suggested cached-caller API expansion in this focused prerequisite; cached observed-vlog stats are not claimed to be a combined leaf/revision report.

Current source: [observed-source return type](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/852aa29e1eed3511f93aba244aef917c89d033e8/TreeDB/caching/db.go#L5558), [separate leaf side call](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/852aa29e1eed3511f93aba244aef917c89d033e8/TreeDB/caching/db.go#L5650), [direct backend partial-stats return](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/852aa29e1eed3511f93aba244aef917c89d033e8/TreeDB/db/leaf_generation_gc.go#L92).
